title: Casa Bluebird, Hendersonville Retreat-Sleeps 12!
description:
City Lights or Country Nights? Have both. 
Escape to this updated brick basement rancher with 2,300+ sq ft of comfort. Enjoy two dens, two outdoor entertaining areas, and a screened-in back porch for morning coffee or evening wind-downs. Sleeps 12 people. Ample parking and easy access—just 20 minutes to Nashville with shopping, dining, music, and nightlife nearby—while still enjoying peaceful country privacy. Perfect for weekend getaways or longer stays.
